expected.label: Left stick
expected.notes: The stick click and four digital directions share this physical stick. Digital directions are tap actions; continuous X/Y values are analog. L3/R3 are not separate arrows.

expected.label: Right stick
expected.notes: The stick click and four digital directions share this physical stick. Digital directions are tap actions; continuous X/Y values are analog. L3/R3 are not separate arrows.

expected.label: L2
expected.notes: SOFT and FULL are two digital stages of one trigger, both under tap. Their LAYER_2 variants stay on this trigger; continuous trigger pressure is analog.

expected.label: R2
expected.notes: SOFT and FULL are two digital stages of one trigger, both under tap. Their LAYER_2 variants stay on this trigger; continuous trigger pressure is analog.

expected.label: L4
expected.notes: Rear grip button; anchor is in the rear-button inset below the front face.

expected.label: L5
expected.notes: Rear grip button; anchor is in the rear-button inset below the front face.

expected.label: R4
expected.notes: Rear grip button; anchor is in the rear-button inset below the front face.

expected.label: R5
expected.notes: Rear grip button; anchor is in the rear-button inset below the front face.

expected.label: Left trackpad
expected.notes: All four digital directions and their LONG_PRESS actions belong to this trackpad. X/Y_POS are continuous pad position, not stick axes. No separate pad click Action ID exists.

expected.label: Right trackpad
expected.notes: All four digital directions and their LONG_PRESS actions belong to this trackpad. X/Y_POS are continuous pad position, not stick axes. No separate pad click Action ID exists.

expected.label: Gyro
expected.notes: FORWARD and BACKWARD name digital gyro actions, so they use tap. PITCH, YAW and ROLL carry continuous values under analog. The anchor marks a gyro tile, not a physical button.
